entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. Text: all four mutations strongly reduced HTRA1 protease activity compared to wild type in cell-free beta-casein degradation assays.
entries.snippet: All mutations strongly reduced HTRA1 protease activity compared to wild-type (wt) HTRA1 in cell-free β-casein degradation assays (Fig. 1c and Supplementary Fig. 1a).

experimental_context.endpoint: proteolytic activity on beta-casein, Tau or a peptide substrate; oligomeric state; brain-vessel protein abundance of HtrA1 and of substrates (Ltbp4, Prss23)

entries.proposition: Figure 1C as drawn: wild type clears the substrate in about 7 minutes; A252T (a trimer) in about 18 minutes; R274Q and R166H in about 32 minutes; A173T leaves about half of the substrate at 32 minutes. entries.proposition: Figure 6D as drawn (relative activity per picomole of enzyme): wild type rises from about 70 to about 300 with the peptide (Vmax about 260), while R274Q rises from about 2 to about 11 (Vmax about 14) on a different axis; R274Q at saturating peptide therefore reaches about 16 percent of the activity of untreated wild type. INFERENZA, reader's: this compares two panels of one figure, which the text sets at different enzyme concentrations (30 nanomolar wild type, 300 nanomolar R274Q).
